scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with verified calculus identities and reproducible numeric checks; finite computation is not a universal proof. No priority, field-validation, or external-certification claim.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three generations of deterministic Nicholson–Bailey host–parasitoid dynamics with one initial additive parasitoid release. No density regulation, survival carryover, field data, stochasticity, or asymptotic suppression theorem. Related 1982/1985 parasitoid inundation papers have not been fully inspected; broader mathematical coverage remains possible.
title: A sharp release-dose threshold for third-generation host resurgence in the Nicholson–Bailey model
